name: Can you paint over the vinyl-covered wall panels in a mobile home?

mainEntity.name: Can you paint over the vinyl-covered wall panels in a mobile home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, vinyl-covered manufactured home walls can be painted successfully if you use the proper primer. These factory panels have a slick, non-porous vinyl film over gypsum board, which standard latex wall paint cannot stick to on its own. The surface must first be cleaned thoroughly with a degreaser to remove dirt and oils, then lightly scuffed. Applying a dedicated bonding primer, such as a high-adhesion shellac or oil-based primer, is required before rolling on standard interior acrylic latex paint. If you skip this specialized prep step, the new finish will easily scratch off, bubble, or peel over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can paint vinyl wall panels, but they require deep cleaning, light scuffing, and a high-adhesion bonding primer before applying interior acrylic latex paint to prevent peeling.
